title: Doric's Task V (miniquest)
start: Speak to Doric in his hut just outside the gates of Taverley north of Falador.

recommended.t: Falador Teleport or activated Falador lodestone
Ardougne Teleport or activated Ardougne lodestone; optionally, the Kandarin monastery Teleport can be used after completing the easy Ardougne achievements.

steps.t: Speak to Doric in his hut north of Falador. [Chat: 1 Do you have any more Smithing tasks for me? › Accept]
Smith 4 Gnome platebodies on Doric's anvil.

sub.t: Have 4 steel platebodies in the backpack to make them.

steps.t: Smith 3 rune swords +1 on any anvil.
Talk to Commander Montai on the Battlefield south of Ardougne.
